proposals.defect: Server-status fallback is bounded to a narrow range (500-503), so other 5xx statuses like 504 or 599 not in the explicit retryable set are treated as permanent instead of retryable.

The non-retryable status check is moved ahead of the retryable check, so any status present in both sets (e.g. 429 or 408 if listed as caller errors) is classified as permanent rather than retryable. Also the retryable set lookup is skipped for caller/auth statuses.
